goal: Make proxy generation stale/recovery observable using existing persistent runtime and worker failure state, without adding a new telemetry subsystem.
context: Use existing accounts runtime_status/runtime_status_detail and worker_item_failures. When a stale-generation mutation is rejected, persist a specific non-secret runtime status/detail for the account. When a fresh runtime later passes the mutation-generation guard, clear only that stale-generation status back to READY. Keep secrets, proxy credentials, and raw URLs out of status text. Preserve all existing provider error states and do not add schema.
commit_message: feat(proxy): expose stale runtime recovery state
